title: What Can Component-Replacement Evidence Establish? A Critical Scoping Review of Local Decisions in LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2609.39989v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Background. A component replacement in a language-model agent changes an execution trajectory, potentially altering later observations, resource use, and recovery opportunities. Different evidence is needed to assess its task-level benefit and the contribution of local decision quality. Methods. This critical scoping review maps 348 studies and examines 90 comparison records: 88 from 40 included studies and two from supplementary studies. Eight purposively selected cases structure the synthesis around the replaced decision, executed conditions, measurement comparability, controls, and remaining explanations. Results. Of 222 studies reporting local decision metrics, 142 also report measured task endpoints and 49 report proxies. These counts identify studies that report both types of measurement, without establishing that the measurements come from matched comparisons. translated_title: 组件替换证据能确立什么？——关于大语言模型智能体局部决策的批判性范围综述
translated_abstract: 背景：语言模型智能体中的组件替换会改变执行轨迹，可能影响后续的观察结果、资源使用以及恢复机会；要评估其任务层面的收益以及局部决策质量的贡献，需要不同的证据。方法：本批判性范围综述梳理了348项研究，并考察了90条比较记录，其中88条来自40项纳入研究，2条来自补充研究；八个有目的地选取的案例围绕被替换的决策、执行条件、测量的可比性、对照设置以及剩余的其他解释来组织综合分析。结果：在报告局部决策指标的222项研究中，有142项同时报告了实测的任务终点指标，49项报告了替代指标；这些数字仅能识别出同时报告两类测量的研究，并不能确立这些测量来自匹配的比较。Outcome Monitors报告了一个包级完成度增益，其归因（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 该批判性范围综述梳理348项研究后发现，LLM智能体组件替换研究大多缺乏将局部决策指标与任务级结果相联系且带匹配对照的比较，因此现有证据难以确立局部决策质量对任务收益的因果贡献。
en_tdlr: This critical scoping review of 348 studies finds that component-replacement evidence in LLM agent research rarely rests on matched comparisons linking local decision metrics to measured task-level outcomes, limiting what such evidence can establish.
